49ers defeat Vikings in Mexico City NFL game

The San Francisco 49ers defeated the Minnesota Vikings in Mexico City during Week 11 of the NFL season. Quarterback Brock Purdy and the 49ers' offense were able to overcome the Vikings' defense. The game featured predictions about whether the Vikings' defensive coordinator Brian Flores' strategy would succeed against the 49ers' offense led by Kyle Shanahan.
